Description

One And Two Bedroom Apartments - Nestled in the tree-lined streets of Hamilton Township, Greenwood Village offers spacious one and two bedroom apartment homes. You are close to everything when you live at Greenwood Village because you are conveniently located close to schools, shopping and many of New Jersey & Pennsylvania's major highways. Our lovely garden-style community is beautifully landscaped and the solid construction of our brick buildings provide you a place you'll be proud to call Home.

Virtual Tours

Community Amenities

  • Trash Collection Included
  • 24 Hour Emergency Maintenance
  • BBQ and Picnic Area
  • Garage Rentals
  • Near Public Transportation
  • On Site Laundry Facilities
  • On Site Property Management
  • Playground
  • Resident Satisfaction Award Winning Community
  • Mandatory One-Time Fees (paid by all applicants): $39 for online applications, $50 for paper application
  • Mandatory One-Time Fees (paid only by adult non-leaseholders on conditionally-approved applications) - $25 background check
  • Mandatory One-Time Fees (paid by approved applicants prior to move-in): $75 Inspection Fee
  • Optional Monthly Fees (paid by resident): $17/month Renter's Insurance, $135/month Garage Rent

Apartment Features

  • Heat & Hot Water Included
  • Water & Sewer Included
  • Air Conditioning
  • Carpeting
  • Ceiling Fan
  • Window Treatments
  • Refrigerator
  • Upgraded Kitchens & Bathrooms in Select Units
  • Private Entrances in Select Units
  • Controlled Access in Select Units

Pet Policy

  • No Pets Allowed. Service & Support Animals Permitted with Health Provider Verification.
